selection: Seven Packagist-ranked paths have passed valid controls: seld/jsonlint (252,371,311 downloads), laminas/laminas-json (35,102,503, forced own PHP Decoder), halaxa/json-machine (30,443,415, own stream Parser plus ext/json member decoding), salsify/json-streaming-parser (7,715,575, own character state machine with listener events), pcrov/jsonreader (1,520,757, own pull lexer/state machine), boundwize/jsonrecast (702,666, own lexer and recursive-descent AST parser; string tokens unescaped by ext/json), and laktak/hjson (262,430, own Hjson character parser; JSON superset).
uncertainty: Seven PHP JSON third-party paths passed valid nested object controls and source-line coverage. Laminas, JSON Machine, salsify and pcrov also passed a valid nested array control and stable source-line AFL feedback. Laminas is abandoned, and its own decoder runs only when explicitly enabled; its default API route delegates to ext/json. JSON Machine shares ext/json for member decoding. salsify accepts only object/array roots and silently accepts concatenated documents, so its harness rejects anything other than one complete document; the tree-building listener is harness code. Own-parser leads klkvsk/json-decode-stream and eftec/services_json passed a screening probe on both valid controls and await pinned projects; joelwurtz/json-stream-polyfill and three low-download supplemental hits remain uninspected. bcncommerce/json-stream (lossy Reader, identical package lines on both controls) and symfony/json-streamer (a schema-free read is one json_decode call) are excluded after pinned probes; salsify forks and listener wrappers and json_decode wrappers, including colinodell/json5 on both valid controls, are excluded. pcrov/jsonreader has a separate lexer and state machine, with three parser-source features and AFL tuples differing between the valid controls. boundwize/jsonrecast builds a formatting-preserving AST with its own lexer and recursive-descent parser; string escapes are ext/json on single tokens, and most of its 35-line control differential is in the indentation-detection pass that parse() runs. laktak/hjson parses a JSON superset and is counted only for valid JSON; it drops an empty member name and lets duplicates overwrite by source reading. The bounded search used thirteen Packagist queries of at most 100 hits each: five captured at 03:23 UTC and eight supplemental queries (json stream, json5, jsonc, json lexer, json tokenizer, json reader, hjson, json pull parser) captured at 15:19 UTC. Packagist matches json5, jsonc and hjson loosely, so their first 100 hits are mostly generic JSON packages. Rankings use the 03:23 download values, which cover every selected path. Package downloads measure overall/historical adoption, not JSON parsing frequency. Valid controls do not establish complete RFC 8259 support.
